The Label

About

Black Casket Records is an underground label and distro operating since 2019. Founded by Angr in Kyiv, Ukraine, and developed after relocating to Latvia.

We release and distribute black metal, doom, dungeon synth, dark ambient — on cassette, vinyl, and digital. Every release is carefully selected and physically produced with attention to detail.

The label also operates as a distro, working with independent artists and small labels from across the underground scene. Releases from Drakkar, The Sinister Initiative, and many others are available through our shop.
